Class RemotePlayerInterpolationHandler

java.lang.Object
com.viaversion.viafabricplus.bedrock.movement.RemotePlayerInterpolationHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
BedrockPlayerPitch, net.minecraft.world.entity.InterpolationHandler
public final class RemotePlayerInterpolationHandler extends Object implements net.minecraft.world.entity.InterpolationHandler, BedrockPlayerPitch
Decorates the real host handler so ordinary Java and unsupported modes retain their existing path.
